title: Tier key certificate
description: The consumer's issuing institution certifies one hardware-held key per Authorization Tier, bound to the enrolled root identity (§7.2), with the tier's EKU (§7.4): Tier 1 READ/DISCOVER/PRESENT, Tier 2 INITIATE, Tier 3 EXECUTE. A JSON form of the certificate policy AFSP-07 will define for X.509. Reference proposal: AFSP v0.1 leaves this format to the Technical Working Group (§18); this schema documents the reference implementation's proposal and is not normative AFSP.

issuer_institution_id.description: Issuing institution holding the consumer's KYC record (§7.2).

root_key_thumbprint.description: Thumbprint of the enrolled TEE root key (§7.2).

eku.description: Action classes this key may sign (VAL-08a).
